name: Takara Sushi Cooked Unagi (Freshwater Eel) & Avocado Roll or Unagi Don
whyItWorks: Broiled freshwater eel (unagi) is fully cooked, ultra-soft, rich in omega-3s and vitamins A/E, and glazed with a gentle sweet soy tare over white sushi rice and creamy avocado.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Eel & Avocado Roll (or Unagi Don rice bowl) with no cucumber strips and light sesame seeds.
watchOuts: Skip spicy mayo and pickled ginger if sensitive
